name: a single Discogs table's head gets the MusicBrainz column though its rows never do
why: vzell's search-page screenshot: every heading after the column sat one column off its cells.

name: the same on the Marketplace page (covered: no Title or Name column)
why: _dgMbDecorateTable() puts the column after a 'Title' or 'Name' heading; the Marketplace and images tables have neither, so the old condition never reached them. Only the search table (Title) was broken. The spec still pins the Marketplace table's shape.
